validity.description: Synthetic competing rates selected to verify residence-sensitive, normalized likelihood calculations without changing entity ownership or route.

sources.citation: Wendt, Regine (2024), Einsatz von Nanotechnologien in der Präzisionsmedizin, Section 4.4, pp. 128-129
sources.role: local nanodevice position, residence, retention, adhesion, and extravasation requirements

sources.citation: MEHLISSA Next M4.6 capillary entity-observation contract, version 1.0.0
sources.role: synthetic rates, competing-risk calculation, buffering, and non-state-changing semantics

limitations: All rates are synthetic software-test values and are not physiological nanodevice interaction parameters.
Reported likelihoods are observations only; this profile does not retain, adhere, extravasate, remove, or reroute an entity.
Rates are constant competing hazards applied only to capillary-region residence time and omit geometry, surface chemistry, cell state, flow, and concentration dependence.
A state-changing model requires an explicit terminal ownership and tissue-entry contract in a later increment.
